integrity.numerical_checks: supplementary reproducible 60-digit solving and quadrature; not a substitute for infinite proof
integrity.proof_method: analytic operator averaging, strict L1 convex optimum crossing argument, uniqueness by shared zeros

scientific_limitations: The exact norm is defined by a unique finite trigonometric system, not elementary radicals.
Only the even convolution optimizer is proved unique; uniqueness of arbitrary admissible operators is not claimed.
Historical priority was reviewed against identified primary work but has not been independently certified.
title: Exact degree-three positivity-loss constant for first-harmonic Fourier reproduction
